title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook and metrics integration for regression/quality gating
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: add a lightweight per-prompt CI hook that runs the eval-harness subset for changed prompt-sets and emits prompt-level regression and quality metrics back to CI so we can gate PRs on model/eval regressions. This PR introduces a new CI hook script, a small metrics reporter, and wiring to GitHub Actions so that prompt-set changes automatically trigger per-prompt checks. Goals: 1) detect regressions at prompt granularity, 2) fail fast in CI for clear regressions, 3) upload metrics to our metrics pipeline for dashboarding and historical tracking. Includes fallback mode (non-blocking) for early rollout.
commit_summary: feat(eval): add scripts/ci/per_prompt_eval_hook.py to run target prompts and collect metrics
feat(ci): add .github/workflows/per-prompt-eval.yml to run hook on PRs touching prompts/**
chore(test): add small sample prompt sets and a mock eval runner for CI unit tests
diff_highlights: + new CI workflow triggers on paths: eval-harness/prompt-sets/**
+ per_prompt_eval_hook.py: runs eval-harness against changed prompt set, computes delta vs baseline, emits JSON metrics
+ metrics/reporter.py: small uploader to CI artifact store and optional metrics endpoint (no credentials in CI)
review_comments: Avery Brooks (review): overall looks good, please add a unit test for the thresholding logic and make the non-blocking rollout the default (we can flip to blocking after a week)
Author (Maya Chen): added unit test and updated default to non-blocking; noted in docs that teams can opt-in to blocking gating with label 'prompts/gate'
Ramesh Kumar (review): CI run failed on initial push due to a missing dependency in the runner image (psycopg2). Suggest pinning docker image and adding a minimal requirements.txt for the CI job.
Author (Maya Chen): updated workflow to use redwood/ci-runner:2025-10 and added requirements-ci.txt; re-ran CI
Priya Natarajan (approval): approving after small nits fixed; flagged that metrics naming should follow 'eval.prompt.{metric}' convention
ci_checks: Initial GitHub Actions run: failed (missing dependency) - addressed in follow-up commit
Second run: lint (pass), unit tests (pass), per-prompt-eval (pass with non-blocking warnings for one prompt), upload artifact (pass)
Final: all checks green; artifacts uploaded to CI for dashboard ingestion
notes_on_rollout: Default is non-blocking: hook reports regressions as warnings into CI and uploads artifacts. Teams can opt into strict gating by adding label 'prompts/gate' to the PR or enabling project-level gating in eval-harness config. We will monitor false positives for one week before enabling blocking by default.
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hook that runs eval-harness for changed prompt sets, emits per-prompt regression/quality metrics, and integrates with CI to optionally gate PRs. Non-blocking by default; opt-in gating via label or project config.
